Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.
PhD student: Plant RNA Biology
The Wachter group at the Institute for Molecular Physiology (Faculty 10: Biology of Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz) investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants. Our recent work identified a structured mRNA element that regulates specific DEAD-box helicase genes and revealed their critical role in controlling alternative splicing. Intriguingly, these functions appear to be linked to unique C-terminal features of the respective helicases. As a member of an interdisciplinary and international research team, you will investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the splicing-regulatory activity of these DEAD-box helicases, with a particular focus on the functional relevance of RGG motifs, subcellular localisation, and their potential involvement in phase separation. In collaboration with the Weinberg group (University Halle-Wittenberg), you will also explore how helicase targeting of pre-mRNA structural elements may intersect with the binding of splicing regulators to determine splice site choice. Your research will employ a multidisciplinary approach that integrates molecular biology, RNA biochemistry, cell biology, and plant physiology, with Arabidopsis thaliana as the primary model system. You will benefit from extensive expertise, various core facilities, and a completely new research infrastructure. The PhD project is funded by the DFG and can be integrated in the international PhD programme (IPP) in Mainz.
Applying state-of-the-art techniques for gene-specific and genome-wide analyses of RNA biology, including transcriptome-wide profiling of alternative splicing and mapping of protein-RNA interactions
Employing in vitro and in vivo experimental systems to address different levels of complexity and advance our understanding of the biological functions
Contributing to teaching activities for Bachelor’s and Master’s students within our group
Assisting with organizational and administrative tasks
Presenting your research findings in oral and written form, including conference contributions, reports, and manuscripts

A successfully completed scientific university degree in Biology or in a related field
Practical experience with a spectrum of molecular methods
A background in plant molecular biology and/or RNA biology
Very good English language skills (at least level B2)
A fascination for science, very good communication, and teamwork skills

Discounted Deutschlandticket
Flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation and fair rules for balancing work and family life
Together, we are advancing science and society on this lively and dynamic campus
A wide range of offers for the development of your talents and perspectives
Opportunity to participate in general university sports programs

**Do you enjoy bridging the gap between people and departments? Do you find it easy to communicate with different audiences and are interested in both the business and technical aspects of your work? Then we have the right position for you! Vestas is looking for a Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist (m/f/d)!**

Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Technical Operations North 

Technical Operations is part of Service NCE (Northern & Central Europe) and supports the organization in the installation and maintenance of a variety of SCADA systems for the control of medium- and large-scale wind turbines. Our mission is to transform a group of wind turbines into a fully operational power plant that meets contractual and regional requirements. Your tasks 

As a Plant Operations Specialist, you are the technical anchor point for the entire department. You will report directly to the Director and contribute to the strategic and technical direction of the division.

- Maintain an overview of new research and development (R&D) products and accompany their operational implementation
- Actively support technical escalations and risks for our business
- Be the point of contact for our four technical communities and ensure that initiatives are aligned and add value to the business

You will be part of an operational department, but at the same time you will have the overarching perspective.

- Degree or comparable educational background in information technology, automation technology or telecommunications
- Strong leadership skills, for example as a project manager or manager
- knowledge of the wind energy industry; Experience with SCADA systems is an advantage
- Fluent in written and spoken English

Competencies

- Excellent communication skills as well as the ability to convey complex technical topics in an understandable way
- Professional skills in stakeholder management
- Ability to work independently and set the technical direction for a team

What we offer 

We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, cooperative and international working environment within renewable energies. We attach great importance to initiative, a sense of responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. With the appropriate motivation, performance and potential, you will have attractive career prospects within Vestas.

Learn more

jobs.description:
Company Description

We Are Wholesale. We turn opportunities into results, shaping the future of wholesale.

At METRO, we’re more than a global food wholesaler. We are ONE METRO: a diverse team of over 85,000 colleagues across more than 30 countries, united by one mission: enabling our 15 million customers to create meaningful moments in hospitality and independent trade.

We shape the M with passion, commitment, and growth mindset. This means taking on responsibility, making our company your company and creating a business together that remains true to its roots but always seeks new solutions.

Job Description

Do you have a passion for digital marketing, e-commerce, and data-driven decision-making? Would you like to gain hands-on experience in a growing Wholesale Media business while working with international teams and leading technology partners? Then join our Global Wholesale Media team.

Wholesale Media is METRO's Retail Media business, connecting supplier brands with professional customers across Europe's leading international food wholesaler. As part of our team, you will contribute to shaping and growing this exciting business area across multiple European markets.

As a Wholesale Media Business Expert, you will support the planning, execution, and optimization of Wholesale Media campaigns across multiple European countries. Working closely with local teams, external partners and ad operations, you will help ensure campaigns are delivered successfully and generate measurable business impact. You will also contribute to shaping and evolving our Wholesale Media strategy by providing performance insights, supporting strategic initiatives and helping to identify opportunities for growth across markets.

- Support the Squad Lead in developing and delivering the overall Wholesale Media strategy for Metro.
- Collaborate with the Squad Lead and cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns align with business objectives and partner requirements.
- Follow Digital Media trends, ad tech developments, and competitive positioning, translating market intelligence into actionable Metro strategies.
- Ensure that we hit our Wholesale Media revenue target end-to-end — from pushing countries to secure more local campaigns, continuous tracking of all digital/media KPIs, forecasting, and corrective action when performance deviates.
- Support the Squad Lead in partnering with the global procurement team to negotiate and secure optimal partner budgets.
- Develop and work with local Wholesale Media Champions across markets — providing guidance, toolkits, and performance frameworks to enable consistent execution globally.
- Represent Wholesale Media priorities across squads and platforms to secure resource allocation and development support from Squads including but not limited to M.Web, M.Shop, M.Companion, Metro Markets and other solutions to ensure smooth campaign operations and feature development.
- Present Wholesale Media projects to countries, customers and Metro Markets, providing continuous updates on revenue performance by channel, country and customer.
- Coordinate campaign delivery with local teams, media partners, and the Ad Operations team.
- Oversee campaign setup, creative approvals and ensure adherence to campaign plans.
- Ensure media plans, creative assets and campaign requirements are delivered on time and respecting METROs B2B DNA.
- Build and maintain dashboards to track campaign performance, optimize and create processes for effective collaboration with internal & external teams.
- Provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders to optimize media ROI.
- Support the external presence of our Wholesale Media offering by supporting presentations, customer meetings, industry events and trade fairs, helping to strengthen our market presence.

Qualifications

- 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing, media, e-commerce, retail media, or a related field.
- Basic understanding of digital advertising and performance marketing KPIs such as CTR, ROAS, and conversions.
- Possess strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and translate insights into actionable campaign optimizations.
- Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics or Looker Studio.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate technical and business information clearly and effectively to various stakeholders.

Additional Information

- Work-life balance: Flexible working hours with the option of mobile working in agreement with your line manager, 30 days of holidays.
- Training: A comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally.
- Well-being: Health days with lots of health checks and information about your well-being, company medical care including a range of preventive services, such as flu shots, OTHEB employee assistance program.
- Exciting life on campus: Free gym and sports classes, Rioba coffee bar, canteen with discounted meals for employees, many campus events.
- Discounts: discounted Jobticket as well as discounts in our wholesale stores and at many partner companies.
- Comfort: Good transport connections, free parking spaces, JobBike.
- Company pension plan: You will receive a contribution to your company pension.
- Family driven: Three daycare centers for children on campus, support of holiday camps for children of employees.
- Ready to build what’s next? Find us at careers.metroag.de and follow us on Instagram (@metro_careers) and Linkedin (@METRO/makro).

OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. We at Boehringer Ingelheim Medicine share one vision: to turn patient-focused innovations into life-changing treatments. We focus on driving medical innovation, combining scientific and patient insights to develop and deliver safe and effective solutions. By concentrating on first-in-class innovations, we aim to set new standards for patient care now and for years to come.
We build on the strongest of all our assets: Our people. We are an agile team with diverse skills, always striving for excellence. We embrace new technologies and trends, make use of broad data, and lead analytics. Our professional ethos reflects our personal values. Above all, we are united by our passion for improving healthcare and the enduring commitment to delivering valuable solutions that transform lives today, tomorrow and beyond.
The Senior Global Medical Manager designs and drives integrated and global medical affairs evidence strategies for Rheumatology/Pulmonology and Inflammation compounds, leads strategic initiatives and provides expert guidance. Acts as a medical ambassador for the brand, engages internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful commercialization and lifecycle management.

- Collaborate closely with brand teams and clinical development to create compelling medical narratives and medical affairs plans aligned with brand strategy.
- Lead publication planning, data dissemination, and execution of critical medical activities such as clinical trials and external collaborations.
- Chair and actively participate in global medical teams and cross-functional leadership groups, offering expert medical guidance.
- Provide medical and scientific expertise for educational programs, symposia, and communication campaigns.
- Engage proactively with external stakeholders, including Specialty HCPs, expert groups, patient organizations, health authorities, and payers, while monitoring the competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions.

Requirements

- A completed MD, PhD, or equivalent degree in fields related to human health, such as Medicine or Pharmacy, is essential with long-term expertise in Rheumatology/Pulmonology and Inflammation
- Extensive experience in clinical development, incl. medical affairs, ideally in global oversight,
- Demonstrate deep knowledge in integrated evidence generation, extending beyond Boehringer-sponsored clinical trials, including dissemination through scientific publications
- A strong background in leading and collaborating within matrix teams at global, regional, or local levels
- Outstanding communication abilities, complemented by skills in delivering presentations, conducting training, and facilitating discussions effectively

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Do you want to shape how a global manufacturing network thinks about data, AI, and the cloud? As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) Cloud & AI, you will  work within the Process Digitalization unit, you will design end-to-end solutions on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake that power production, sales, and finance domains alike. Also, you will lead the implementation of AI-driven workflows, e.g. integrating Azure OpenAI, building ML pipelines, and modernizing legacy systems, while also guiding executive leadership on strategic priorities. Every day, you'll balance ambitious architectural thinking with the satisfaction of shipping real, scalable solutions that move the organization toward a truly cloud-native future.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Designing scalable, secure Azure and Snowflake architectures by translating complex requirements from the global manufacturing network into future-proof cloud solutions
* Leading hands-on implementation of cloud and ML solutions by integrating Azure OpenAI into live data workflows and deploying robust CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
* Driving modernization of legacy systems and automate data flows across production, sales, and finance domains to support a leaner, cloud-native organization
* Acting as a senior thought leader and sparring partner for Azure-based applications, owning the documentation and scaling of architectural designs across the organization
* Communicate architectural strategies and project outcomes clearly to both executive leadership and technical teams, bridging vision and delivery with confidence

What You Bring

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cloud Engineering, or a related field, paired with many years of experience in cloud architecture
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure and Snowflake including AI/ML integration, Python, SQL, and API development with a proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions
* Strong strategic planning and influencing skills: you're as comfortable shaping a multi-year architecture roadmap as you are aligning stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), generative AI services, and cloud-based modernization of enterprise systems
* You are business fluent in English; fluency in German is a strong plus

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

For Applicants applying from Austria:

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of 54.439,39 € gross/year for a full-time position (38,5 h/week).

Glycothera is a specialized CDMO supporting biologics development across cell line development, process development, analytics, and GMP-aligned testing. Operating from integrated sites in Julich and Hanover, Germany, the company works within a unified scientific and quality framework that enables reliable, regulatory-ready CMC execution. With nearly three decades of development experience and long-standing contributions to biologics supported by EMA and FDA approvals, Glycothera partners with biotech and pharmaceutical companies to advance development programs with scientific depth, precision, and consistency.

Scientist (m/f/d) Functional Assay
(full-time, permanent)

For our site in Jülich (Germany) we are looking for a highly motivated Bench Scientist to join our Functional Assay team. The main area of responsibility will be the development and execution of cell-based functional assays. In addition, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to work closely with the binding group to conduct Biacore/SPR assays.
Perform, evaluate and document experiments for method development of functional assays, including cell-based assays (e.g. potency, CDC, ADCC, ADCP, apoptosis assay, proliferation assay) and binding assays (e.g. Biacore/SPR) according to ICH guidelines.
Handle cell lines and primary cells (e.g. isolation, freezing, thawing, propagation, testing).
Analyze samples to support the development of therapeutic candidates across various departments/process steps.
Perform, evaluate and document functional assays for analytical similarity and comparability studies.
Draft regulatory documents, including SOPs, R&D-Procedures and development reports.
Support method validation and method transfer activities.
Take care of laboratory equipment (e.g., perform instrument maintenance and qualification) and support laboratory management tasks.
The role will be primarily lab-based.

B.Sc. in relevant scientific discipline (life sciences such as biology, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, biotechnology, etc.) with minimum 3-5 years of relevant work experience, or M.Sc. with 1-2 years of relevant work experience.
Experience working with mammalian cell lines under aseptic conditions, including culture initiation, propagation and cryopreservation is a must. Separation and purification of primary human cells is a plus.
Experience with potency and bioassay development (e.g., CDC, ADCC, proliferation, apoptosis) for monoclonal antibody analysis is required. Experience with other modalities is a plus.
Experience with relevant analytical methods (e.g., ELISA formats, Flow Cytometry) is required.
Experience with biochemical and biophysical methods for binding characterization (e.g., Biacore/SPR) is advantageous.
Attention to detail and precise work habits.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient in using a PC and common Microsoft packages. Experience with specific laboratory instrumentation (e.g., Biacore T200 and 8K, MSD, Flow cytometer, microplate reader) and analysis software (e.g., SoftMax, Methodical Mind, MACSQuantify, Biacore Insight) is a plus.

You are a smart, proactive and solution-driven scientist with a hands-on attitude who is able to independently progress projects, prioritize tasks adequately and work against tight timelines. At the same time, you maintain a high-quality standard in your work, support the team and foster a sense of positivity. If this sounds like you, then join us in shaping what’s next!

Language: English, German is beneficial.

Work Experience: Industrial work experience (biotechnology/biopharma) is highly appreciated. Our Jülich site with currently 40 employees offers an innovative, vibrant and multicultural environment that gives you the chance to bring in all of your competencies, and together with a highly motivated team drive the change and develop personally. jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Release Train Engineer (RTE) you are the operational lead of our Steam Turbine New Unit Agile Release Train (ART) – around 100 people from design, engineering, validation, industrialization and product management, working together across several sites in Europe and beyond. 

You keep development flowing across these disciplines and locations, make our cadence and events count and turn strategy into predictable delivery. You are the person who sees the whole train, anticipates where it will slow down and clears the track before it becomes a problem.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Plan and facilitate PI Planning end-to-end and run ART Sync, System Demos and Inspect & Adapt, so that alignment and transparency work even across distributed teams and time zones 
* Together with Product Management and Business Owners, keeping the ART backlog aligned to portfolio priorities and translate a complex hardware roadmap into commitments the teams can actually deliver 
* Making delivery predictable by tracking progress against real outcomes – the System Demo, not status slides – and by managing risks and dependencies across the value stream from concept to industrialization
* Keeping the flow moving by maintaining the ART Kanban, making work-in-progress visible, using flow metrics such as predictability and flow time to spot bottlenecks early and resolving or escalating impediments decisively
* Coaching teams, Product Management, System Architects and Business Owners – not by prescribing process but by asking the right questions and building an environment where problems surface early and openly
* Driving continuous improvement through Inspect & Adapt, communities of practice and the Lean-Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) and creating data-based transparency on ART health for leadership decision

What You Bring

* An engineering or technical degree is welcome – we weigh demonstrated experience, mindset and results at least as highly
* Several years of hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, having led an Agile Release Train through multiple Program Increments – not theory, but demonstrated delivery
* Experience in physical product, engineering or industrial development environments and an understanding of their realities: long lead times, prototypes and testing, supplier and manufacturing dependencies, hardware/software interplay
* Strong practical command of SAFe and Lean-Agile ways of working, ideally backed by a SAFe RTE or SPC certification, combined with a data-driven mindset for flow and delivery metrics 
* Strong facilitation skills and leadership without authority: you align large, distributed groups, steer difficult conversations and gain commitment across functions, sites and cultures
* Fluency in German and English, ease in an international, multi-site engineering environment, and a willingness to travel between locations as needed

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Laborant in der Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Methodenetablierung (Chemielaborant/in)
jobs.description:
Your role: Laboratory Assistant in Quality Control (m/f/d)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

In this technically demanding role, you will be largely responsible for the practical implementation and maintenance of our analytical test procedures. Your focus will be on ensuring robust analysis in accordance with international standards directly in the laboratory.

Your Responsibilities:

- Wide-ranging analysis: You will apply chromatographic (HPLC, GC) and wet chemical methods to ensure precise quality control, maintaining data integrity through GMP-compliant documentation and modern laboratory standards (e.g., 5S).
- Pharmacopoeia compliance: You will independently establish and verify analytical methods according to applicable monographs (e.g. EP, USP) and carry out verifications in regulatory revisions.
- Method optimization & CAPA management: You will experimentally investigate and optimize analytical procedures in the context of deviations and CAPA measures to sustainably increase methodological robustness.
- Conducting validation studies: You will carry out method validations and verifications for new products and feedstocks practically on the device and strictly comply with GMP requirements.
- Securing method transfer (APVs): You will develop "best practices" for analytics and record them in supplementary audit regulations (APVs) to ensure consistent application of the methods across the team.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education: You have completed training as a chemical laboratory assistant (m/f/d), CTA (m/f/d) or a comparable qualification and 2+ years relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical quality control.
- Expertise: You have in-depth, field-tested knowledge in instrumental analysis (HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) as well as in the application of international pharmacopoeia (EP, USP).
- Languages: Fluent German and good English skills for working with international pharmacopoeia.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Methodological competence: Experience in the practical processing of methodological issues in the context of CAPA processes and in the implementation of method validations.
- Way of working: High level of technical understanding of laboratory processes, work reliably in the implementation of complex monographs and passion for working directly in the laboratory.
- IT affinity: Experience with MS Office and chromatography data systems (e.g. Empower) and SAP.

What we offer you – Why Elanco?

- Attractive salary according to the chemical tariff (MTV), full 13th month salary (Christmas bonus) and 40 € holiday pay per day. Plus: employer-financed pension scheme**.**
- Work-life balance: 37.5-hour week and 30 days of vacation. On top of that, there's the "future amount" (up to 5 extra days off or cash), overtime? Are recorded and compensated for by free time**.**
- Well-being: Hansefit membership, annual events (our employee party is legendary!) and preventive care offers directly on site.
- Convenient commute: Subsidy for the job ticket and free parking.
- Benefits: Employee share purchase program and corporate benefits platform.

Additional Information:

- Location: Kiel, Germany - On-site Work Environment
- Travel: 0%
- Position: Limited contract of 2 years.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Hochdruckflüssigkeitschromatografie (HPLC)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

This role provides technical leadership in the establishment, optimization, and scientific validation of complex analytical test methods for new product projects. You will also coordinate quality control project activities and ensure strict regulatory compliance while fostering international exchange to meet key milestones.

Your Responsibilities:

- Method Establishment & Expertise: Technical responsibility for the establishment of new test methods (active ingredients and finished products) as well as their optimization and troubleshooting in complex analytical issues.
- Validation & Verification: Scientific planning (including the application of statistical methods), implementation and evaluation of validations and verifications of analytical methods in the context of new product projects.
- Technical project management: Coordination of project-related activities within quality control and acting as a technical contact person vis-à-vis the higher-level project team. Ensuring close coordination on project milestones and promoting international knowledge exchange.
- Regulatory Compliance & Documentation: Ensuring regulatory compliance within analytical transfer projects as well as drafting and approving audit requirements

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education: Completed university degree in pharmacy or chemistry.
